posts.author: pestercide
posts.body:
Hi thought I'd introduce myself!! Been lurking these forums for a while but finally decided to make an account
I'm pestercide (otherwise known as Grim!) and I'm completely new to RPG Maker. Never messed with it before but my desire to make a game with my characters ended up motivating me to get RPG Maker 2003!
I'm currently working on a game called 'Devil's Advocate' which was loosely inspired by OFF and several RPG Maker horror games. I had wanted to make my own game for years now, with Mario: The Music Box being my introduction to RPG Maker horror!
I'm excited to get started and share updates on the project!
Have a great day/afternoon/night!!

posts.body:
Welcome to the forum! I was also brand new to RPG Maker a few years ago and this forum helped tremendously.
Good luck on your projects and remember to always enjoy what you do!
